Nathan Fielder's Elizabeth Holmes Documentary Trailer Released

The first trailer for Nathan Fielder's documentary about Elizabeth Holmes has been released. Part of the documentary was filmed in the 34 days before Holmes began her 11-year prison sentence in federal prison.
